messages.subject: Move a geom layer
parts:
i have a plot with two layers - raw data points (jittered) in groups,
with a pointrange over the top of the points to show mean/
95%confidence interval.

is it possible to move the geom_pointrange object a little to one side
(ie along the x axis) so that the mean doesnt overlie the jitter plot?
i did some RTFM but i couldnt figure out how to do this.

ggplot() +
geom_pointrange(aes(x = diagnosis,y = height),data=ph,size =
1.0,shape = 16,fun.data = mean_cl_normal,conf.int = 0.95,stat =
'summary') +
geom_jitter(aes(x = diagnosis,y = height),data=ph,size = 1.0,alpha =
0.75,position = position_jitter(height = 0.1,width = 0.1))

thanks
ben
